actual_source_trace: pytest_runtest_setup sets skipped_by_mark_key=True and raises the skip exception inside the framework.
The later skip-location normalization is part of that same elif chain and is therefore never reached under --runxfail.
Terminal output consequently uses the internal skip-raising location in src/_pytest/skipping.py instead of the user test location. The test does not run and the outcome remains skipped.

contracts.contract: --runxfail forces running/reporting xfail-marked tests as though not marked and makes imperative xfail have no effect.
runxfail option is xfail-specific; mark skip reports are normalized to the test item definition.
Production runtest report creation is passed through the skipping hook.
Terminal summaries display locations from skipped reports.

expected: The test remains skipped and the displayed skip location points to the user test item in both runs. --runxfail changes xfail behavior only.
